description.value:
Your blood runs true to kin.

Gift — Once per day, reaction, when an ally within reach is reduced to 0 HP: will a portion of your own vitality into them, and they stabilize automatically, no flat check needed. Tithe — Your blood is different enough to matter; you can't safely receive a normal blood transfusion or a Treat Wounds boost from anyone who hasn't specifically studied your blood first (GM adjudicates the method) — the first attempt each scene simply fails and wastes the action.
